summary: Learn analytics translation to shape AI use cases, prioritize value, and communicate decisions clearly. Enroll for practical 5-day training.
lede: Analytics translation connects business priorities with data and AI delivery so opportunities can become decision-ready work. For business leaders and professionals working with technical teams, the course covers framing and prioritizing use cases, sizing value, and aligning stakeholder roles. It also addresses proof-of-concept success measures, adoption planning, and executive reporting to guide initiatives toward MVP and scale.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to translate analytics demand into business value, coordinate delivery with technical teams, and present decisions clearly to leaders.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Working knowledge of business processes, stakeholder communication, and basic data concepts; no programming is required. Familiarity with KPI reporting, project delivery, or analytics-related initiatives will help you get more from the exercises. Participants should bring a laptop for workshop templates, prioritization exercises, and executive-summary drafting; coding skills are not required, and advanced analytics concepts are taught at an operational, decision-focused level.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
